age.evidence: Adult male Wistar Han rats (280-350 g)

sex.evidence: Adult male Wistar Han rats (280-350 g; Charles River, Sulzfeld, Germany)

psychedelic: Psilocybin (ketamine and MDMA used as comparators)

dosing.evidence: doses of psilocybin (2 and 10 mg/kg)... dissolved in sterile water... All drugs were given intraperitoneally (ip)

enrichment_housing.evidence: an enriched environment was not applied

assays.assay_description: Round black arena (1 m diameter) virtually divided into eight sections; 10 min recording, 20 min after injection (per methods) / 24 h after drug (per results framing). Measures: time of walking, line crossings, peeping under arena, grooming, rearings.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed in the middle of the arena; behavior recorded for 10 min

food_restriction.evidence: Free access to food in home cage; no food in OFT apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: Free access to water in home cage; no water in OFT apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: Behavioral tests showed... rat behavior 24 h after drug administration

sample_size.evidence: n is given under or next to the name of the group (Figure 5)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (2 and 10 mg/kg) did not affect walking time or crossings, whereas ketamine (10 mg/kg) decreased both parameters 24 h post-injection.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin did not affect time of walking and episodes of crossing in the open field test; however, ketamine decreased both parameters

B1_num_measures.evidence: time of walking, number of line crossings, episodes of peeping under the arena, number of grooming events, and number of rearings

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Behavior recorded for 10 min; totals only

B4_ethological.evidence: number of grooming events, and number of rearings

B5_social.evidence: Rats placed individually in the arena

E1_environment_type.evidence: round black arena (1 m in diameter)

E6_spatial.evidence: Virtually divided into eight sections (no physical partitions)

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats placed in the middle of the arena individually

D5_followup.evidence: rat behavior 24 h after drug administration

assays.assay_description: TSE Fear Conditioning System, 45×45×45 cm arena with illuminated light compartment and enclosed dark compartment (33% of area). Single 10 min trial 24 h after drug administration. Measures: transitions, time in each compartment, distance traveled.

setup_habituation.evidence: Animals were kept in total darkness for 1 h prior to testing; no apparatus pre-exposure described

sample_size.evidence: n is given under or next to the name of the group (Figure 5)

outcomes.summary: Time in dark > light for all groups with no treatment effect on time spent (no anxiolytic/anxiogenic effect). Psilocybin 2 mg/kg and ketamine decreased ambulatory distance in both zones; psilocybin 10 mg/kg had no effect.
outcomes.statistics: Time: F3,72=0, p<1.0; light vs dark F1,72=919, p<0.0001. Distance: treatment F3,72=17.4, p<0.0001; light vs dark F1,72=412, p<0.0001
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin at a dose of 2 mg/kg and ketamine significantly decreased exploration of the dark and light zones

B1_num_measures.evidence: number of transitions between the compartments, the time spent in each compartment and locomotor activity (the distance traveled) were measured (time light, time dark, distance light, distance dark, transitions)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Single 10 min trial, total values reported

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Fear Conditioning software (TSE) — position tracking, not behavioural classifier

E1_environment_type.evidence: arena (45 × 45 × 45 cm) with a light and a dark compartment

E2_shelter.evidence: dark compartment made of black acrylic... received no light at all (fully enclosed)

E6_spatial.evidence: light compartment... and a dark compartment... black dividing wall... central tunnel gate

assays.assay_description: Cylinder (50 cm high × 23 cm diameter) filled to 30 cm depth with water (25°C). Day 1: 15 min pre-test; 24 h later: 5 min test (drug given between sessions). Immobility, swimming and climbing time scored by two blind observers.

setup_habituation.evidence: On the first day of the FST (pre-test), the rats were placed individually in a cylinder... for 15 min (pre-test exposure before drug & test)

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats placed in a water-filled cylinder, confined to forced swim apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: Cylinder filled with water; water physically accessible (though not as drinking water)

time_to_assay.evidence: forced swim test (FST) estimated 24 h after administration

sample_size.evidence: n is given under the name of the group (Figure 6)

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin 2 mg/kg increased immobility and swimming time and decreased climbing time; psilocybin 10 mg/kg had no significant effect. Ketamine increased swimming time only. No antidepressant-like reduction in immobility was observed for any treatment.
outcomes.statistics: Immobility F3,76=8.12, p<0.0001; climbing F3,76=15, p<0.0001; swimming F3,76=27, p<0.0001 (one-way ANOVA)
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin at a dose of 2 mg/kg significantly increased immobility and swimming time... while significantly decreasing climbing time. Ketamine only significantly increased swimming time.

B1_num_measures.evidence: measured the swimming, climbing and immobility time

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility/swimming/climbing are not natural ethological behaviours per rubric

E1_environment_type.evidence: cylinder (50 cm high × 23 cm in diameter)

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were placed individually in a cylinder

D1_continuity.evidence: Pre-test 15 min on day 1; retest 5 min 24 h later

D4_baseline.evidence: Pre-test conducted before any drug administration but used to induce stress, not as a baseline measure compared in analysis; data reported is from retest only

judge_notes: Both candidates identified the same three behavioural assays (OFT, LDB, FST); no merging needed across assay identities.
Microdialysis, Western blot, and comet assay were correctly excluded as non-behavioural readouts.
Dosing: added Ketamine and MDMA entries (qwen included ketamine; both omitted MDMA which was administered i.p. as a comparator and is relevant to the dosing record).
OFT B1: scored 2 (4-6) because the methods explicitly list five measures (walking, crossings, peeping, grooming, rearings) even though figures show only two — followed glm.
OFT B4: scored 1 because grooming and rearing are ethological measures listed in methods.
LDB B1: scored 2 (4-6) — time light, time dark, distance light, distance dark, transitions = 5 measures.
FST D2: scored 1 because the pre-test session was 15 min (longest single session); retest was 5 min. Pre-test data are recorded behaviourally even if not used as drug-baseline comparison.
FST D4 set to 0: pre-test occurred before drug but its data is not compared as a pre-drug baseline for the drug effect — the analyzed outcome is from the retest only.
B7 set to 0 for LDB despite TSE Fear Conditioning software — per rubric this is position tracking, not behavioural classification.
